No universal human construction-vehicle chassis, no compulsory twin side engine pods, no bronze nozzle rims unless present in the supplied faction references, no generic two front elbow-arms layout. One complete SPACECRAFT, isolated on perfectly pure black, elevated front three-quarter view showing its tool, all silhouette and tool extremities comfortably inside frame. Entire image is one individual deliverable, not a contact sheet. No terrain, floor, scenery, people, text, labels, logos, watermark, weapons, wheels, tracks, walking legs, smoke, sparks or fantastical floating parts. BRACCATIAN family: ochre/tan continuous barrel-like body, coral/russet rounded end caps, longitudinal grey/dark steel reinforcement strips, rounded attached modules, as in the references. No top tractor cab, no red racing stripes, no overly shiny grey framing, no heavy ornamental knot patterns.
